Roles and permissions

Build prompt

Build “Sponsorship & Major Donor Pipeline” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Track stages from prospect to pledged to received. Assign an owner and due date for logo placement, signage or acknowledgments. Keep pledge balances separate from cash received. Development staff see assigned contacts and private notes. Finance records receipts. Event staff see only their recognition tasks. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A sponsor pledges $5,000 and pays $2,000. Finance sees $3,000 outstanding. Event staff see the logo deadline and cannot read cultivation notes.
